blocks.html: Cabo San Lucas Fishing Charters | Depart from San José del Cabo

Private 6-Hour and 8-Hour Fishing Trips from Puerto Los Cabos Marina

Looking for Cabo San Lucas fishing charters during your vacation in Mexico?

Exotic Fish Cabo offers private sportfishing adventures for visitors staying in Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, and throughout the Los Cabos region.

All our fishing trips depart from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, offering access to productive fishing grounds in the Sea of Cortez.

Whether you're chasing marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado, wahoo, or roosterfish, our experienced local captains provide personalized fishing experiences for beginners, families, and serious anglers.

Why Choose a Fishing Charter from San José del Cabo?

While Cabo San Lucas is famous for its sportfishing traditions, San José del Cabo offers another excellent starting point for fishing adventures in Los Cabos.

Departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina gives anglers access to renowned fishing areas such as Gordo Banks, Iman Bank, and La Fortuna.

Our local captains select fishing locations based on seasonal fish activity, ocean conditions, and your fishing goals.

Whether you're staying in Cabo San Lucas or San José del Cabo, Exotic Fish Cabo can help you discover the fishing opportunities of the Sea of Cortez.

Cabo Fishing Charter Options

6-Hour Private Fishing Charter

Ideal for couples, families, beginners, and experienced anglers looking for a flexible fishing adventure.

Depending on conditions, your trip may focus on inshore, midshore, or offshore fishing.

8-Hour Offshore Fishing Charter

Designed for anglers seeking more time on the water and greater flexibility to explore offshore fishing grounds.

Target seasonal big-game species including marlin, yellowfin tuna, dorado, and wahoo.

Both options include an experienced captain, crew, and quality fishing equipment. Additional arrangements can be confirmed when booking.

What Fish Can You Catch in Los Cabos?

The waters surrounding Los Cabos offer opportunities to target a variety of game fish throughout the year.

  • Marlin: Striped, blue, and black marlin are among the region's most sought-after offshore species.

  • Yellowfin Tuna: Known for powerful runs and challenging fights.

  • Dorado (Mahi-Mahi): Famous for their brilliant colors, fast strikes, and spectacular jumps.

  • Wahoo: A fast offshore predator prized by experienced anglers.

  • Roosterfish: An iconic inshore species found along the Baja California coastline.

Fishing opportunities vary with the season, water temperature, and ocean conditions.

Explore our Fishing Calendar and recent Fishing Reports to learn more about seasonal fishing activity around San José del Cabo.

Staying in Cabo San Lucas? Here's Where Your Fishing Trip Starts

If you're staying in Cabo San Lucas, you can still enjoy a private fishing charter with Exotic Fish Cabo.

Our departures take place exclusively from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo, not from Cabo San Lucas Marina.

Please plan your transportation to the departure marina before your scheduled fishing trip.

Our team will provide meeting instructions and help you choose a charter that matches your fishing goals.

Book Your Cabo Fishing Adventure

Ready to discover the excitement of fishing in Los Cabos?

Choose a private 6-hour or 8-hour fishing charter with Exotic Fish Cabo.

Whether you're visiting Cabo San Lucas, San José del Cabo, or anywhere in Los Cabos, we're here to help you plan a memorable fishing experience on the Sea of Cortez.

Explore Our Private Fishing Charters to view trip options, pricing, and booking information.
